title: The Weekend Courier

subject.declared_circumstances: Part-time retail employment, declared income around 18,000 GBP per year
subject.established_profile: A single monthly salary credit of approximately 1,450 GBP from a named employer, no other regular income, stable and unremarkable balance for six years prior to this activity window

onward_movement.pattern: Each incoming payment was followed within two to four hours by either an ATM cash withdrawal or a card payment, consuming most of the balance each time
onward_movement.destination_note: A mix of cash withdrawals and card spend, no single onward account or destination, only a small residual balance under 10 percent of each credit left behind after every cycle

supporting_facts: None of the four senders share a name, address, or any apparent connection with the account holder or with each other, based on account name matching alone
The account holder's declared occupation and income give no known basis for receiving third-party payments of this kind
When asked informally by a branch staff member about one of the payments, the account holder described it only as 'a friend paying me back', with no further detail offered
The account has held a stable balance with no prior large or third-party-sourced credits for the six years before this activity window
